name: Mizuna

companions.note: Borage repels cabbage worms that also target brassica greens

pnw_notes: Japanese mustard green with feathery, deeply cut leaves. Mild and slightly peppery — less intense than arugula, more interesting than spinach. Very cold hardy; can handle light snow. Vigorous grower that regrows quickly after cutting. Good candidate for cut-and-come-again harvesting throughout fall and winter.

planting_windows.notes: Direct sow; can also start indoors and transplant in late summer
Cut 2 in above soil; plant regrows 2–3 times before quality declines
